lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs in a rectilinear grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, forming roughly four horizontal rows and six visible vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating distinctive anchor nodes across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs of varying sizes contained within the boundary of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, bright yellow biotic attachment, likely a commensal fish, located on the mid-lateral flank just posterior to the gill region.
